items.title: CeeDee Lamb: Notches 70 yards on 18 targets
items.text:
Lamb caught nine of 18 targets for 70 yards in Sunday's 23-13 loss to the Packers.

items.title: Chris Godwin: Another lackluster showing in Week 6 loss
items.text:

items.title: Bucky Irving: Quiet in OT loss to Pittsburgh
items.text:

items.title: Jalon Daniels: Two picks in OT loss to Pittsburgh
items.text:
Daniels completed 22 of 43 passes for 164 yards and one touchdown with two interceptions in Sunday's 26-19 overtime loss to the Steelers. He added 39 rushing yards on four carries.
